title: Native distilled release/* branch receipt envelope, push-policy verification, and local-distill publish-branch
goal: Admit accept-verified functional distillations onto `refs/heads/release/<name>` in Susi Core without weakening `vX.Y.Z` production release tag qualification: wrap `--release-candidate` compositions in a deterministic single-parent envelope commit adding only `releases/distill/<name>.json`, verify canonical `susi-distillation-receipt-v1` SHA-256 + `accept_verified_candidate` + zero-rejected + passing `accept.cmd` evidence inside `xtask/src/push_policy.rs`, and add `publish-branch` / `--publish-release-branch` to `local-distill`.
limitations: Distilled `refs/heads/release/<name>` branches carry an accept-verified `susi-distillation-receipt-v1` envelope (`qualification_status: accept_verified_candidate`), whereas immutable `vX.Y.Z` production release tags continue to require full native exact-tree qualification (`susi-release-qualification/v1`) across Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64.
